title: fit e predict
code:
import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
m = LinearRegression().fit(np.array([[1], [2], [3]]), np.array([3, 5, 7]))
print(round(float(m.predict([[10]])[0]), 1))
